verdict.overall: No Sunday baseline exists for any ticker today, so this is a snapshot of current positioning rather than a trend over time. APP and BE show the most balanced, range-bound setups for swing trades, while TSLA, GOOGL, SPY and QQQ show options leaning against their current trends, adding uncertainty to those ranges. AVGO's earnings land inside this window on December 9, which is the main event-risk to watch; confidence in the cleaner range setups (APP, BE) looks reasonably steady for now.
